id: \rRapp: Yo, what do you think you're doing?
en: \rRapp: Yo, what do you think you're doing?
it: \rRapp: Yo, che cavolo credi di fare?

id: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
en: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
it: \bBenvenuto. Dove vorresti andare?

id: \bCheck out these rare bad boys.
en: \bCheck out these rare bad boys.
it: \bGuarda un po' questi gioiellini rari.

id: \bYou've seen them before?
en: \bYou've seen them before?
it: \bLi hai già visti?

id: \rHapu: What do you think you're doing here!? Are you trying to steal my crops?
en: \rHapu: What do you think you're doing here!? Are you trying to steal my crops?
it: \rHapu: Che cosa credi di fare qui!? Vuoi rubare il mio raccolto?

id: \rHapu: Sorry, I've had a few thieves recently. Won't happen again.
en: \rHapu: Sorry, I've had a few thieves recently. Won't happen again.
it: \rHapu: Scusa, ultimamente ho avuto qualche ladro. Non succederà più.

id: \rYou're looking for the Island Kahuna? I'm afraid I can't help you with that at the moment.
en: \rYou're looking for the Island Kahuna? I'm afraid I can't help you with that at the moment.
it: \rStai cercando il Kahuna dell'isola? Temo di non poterti aiutare, per il momento.

id: Rotom Dex: Maybe we should ask someone in Seafolk Village about the Island Kahuna.
en: Rotom Dex: Maybe we should ask someone in Seafolk Village about the Island Kahuna.
it: Rotom Dex: Forse dovremmo chiedere a qualcuno del Villaggio Marino del Kahuna dell'isola.

id: \rHapu: I'm a little busy right now. Come back later.
en: \rHapu: I'm a little busy right now. Come back later.
it: \rHapu: Adesso sono un po' impegnata. Torna più tardi.

id: \rYou dare cross my path?
en: \rYou dare cross my path?
it: \rOsi incrociare il mio cammino?

id: \rPurely luck.
en: \rPurely luck.
it: \rPura fortuna.

id: \rMallow: I finished my new recipe. Now that I'm done I can help you get ready for your trial.
en: \rMallow: I finished my new recipe. Now that I'm done I can help you get ready for your trial.
it: \rIbis: Ho finito la mia nuova ricetta. Ora che ho finito posso aiutarti a prepararti per la tua prova.

id: \rMallow: I think you're going to do great.
en: \rMallow: I think you're going to do great.
it: \rIbis: Secondo me andrai alla grande.

id: \bGladion: I hear you're also looking for the Island Kuhuna. Let's face each other first to see if we're even ready.
en: \bGladion: I hear you're also looking for the Island Kuhuna. Let's face each other first to see if we're even ready.
it: \bIridio: Ho sentito che anche tu stai cercando il Kahuna dell'isola. Affrontiamoci prima, per vedere se siamo davvero pronti.

id: \bI was going to check out Vast Poni Canyon on the boat over there. Go on ahead. I'll catch up with you.
en: \bI was going to check out Vast Poni Canyon on the boat over there. Go on ahead. I'll catch up with you.
it: \bStavo per andare a dare un'occhiata al Gran Canyon di Poni con quella barca laggiù. Vai pure avanti. Ti raggiungo.

id: \bGladion: I was going to check out Vast Poni Canyon on the boat over there. Go on ahead. I'll catch up with you.
en: \bGladion: I was going to check out Vast Poni Canyon on the boat over there. Go on ahead. I'll catch up with you.
it: \bIridio: Stavo per andare a dare un'occhiata al Gran Canyon di Poni con quella barca laggiù. Vai pure avanti. Ti raggiungo.

id: \bTupp: Yo, these radishes are going to be great for luring in all the Oricorio.
en: \bTupp: Yo, these radishes are going to be great for luring in all the Oricorio.
it: \bTupp: Ehi, questi ravanelli saranno perfetti per attirare tutti gli Oricorio.

id: \rRapp: Yeah, it will be so easy to kidnap them all.
en: \rRapp: Yeah, it will be so easy to kidnap them all.
it: \rRapp: Già, sarà facilissimo rapirli tutti.

id: \bZipp: You don't have a problem with that, do you?
en: \bZipp: You don't have a problem with that, do you?
it: \bZipp: Non hai niente in contrario, vero?

id: \bTupp: No way. Yo, this isn't cool. Let's get out of here.
en: \bTupp: No way. Yo, this isn't cool. Let's get out of here.
it: \bTupp: Non ci credo. Yo, così non è figo. Filiamo via di qui.

id: \bShould I try and find Tapu Fini?
en: \bShould I try and find Tapu Fini?
it: \bDovrei provare a cercare Tapu Fini?

id: \bZipp: Yo yo yo.
en: \bZipp: Yo yo yo.
it: \bZipp: Yo yo yo.

id: \bTapu Fini might not like being bothered.
en: \bTapu Fini might not like being bothered.
it: \bA Tapu Fini potrebbe non piacere essere disturbato.

id: Vast Poni Canyon
en: Vast Poni Canyon
it: Gran Canyon di Poni

id: Exit
en: Exit
it: Esci
